parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The backup ID. You can call the ListUserBackupFiles operation to query the backup ID.

parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The new description of the full backup file.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID.

parameters.name: Retention
parameters.description: The new retention period of the full backup file. Unit: days. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds update-user-backup-file --backup-id b-g14d0m772f7b0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --comment CommentTest --retention 30 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
